answer: Sprinkle tasks whose right answer the operator already knows, audit against that key, and slash the bond of anyone who submits a wrong reply; a fresh nonce per submission also stops a worker recycling yesterday's text. The limit shows up fast, because a careful farm skips unknown tasks and keeps collecting the easy ones, so the decoy catches lazy relays rather than patient ones, and the saffron-tagged traps stay useful only until someone maps them. Honest small operators sit in a haven; copy farms drift to the nadir.
